fusions.name: Rolling Bash
fusions.desc: You roll into the target, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds. You rush up to 6 tiles to reach it.

fusions.name: Barbed Trample
fusions.desc: Tramples through every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 4 damage to each.

fusions.name: Bristling Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Overlap
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
